SOURCE_ID.description:
Publisher-stable, lowercase identifier of the source in the provider's
registry of sources.

SOURCE_KIND.description: What kind of data the source supplies.

Ephemeris.description: Ephemerides: states over time, from an operator or a precise-orbit service

Observation.description: Observations (ranges, angles, other measurements) that states are estimated from

Reference.description: Reference registers of sites and facilities (status, dates, identity)

ORIGINATOR.description:
Agency, operator or catalog that created the source data, as it names
itself. Not a message's CCSDS ORIGINATOR, which names who created the
message.

PROVIDER_ID.description:
Identifier of the provider that published the product, as the provider
names itself: the module, node or service that retrieved the source data.

PRODUCER.description:
Identifier of the software that made the product from the source data,
with its version when it has one.

LICENSE_CLASS.description: What the source's terms permit for the product.

Unspecified.description: Not stated. Never a grant: treated as CiteOnly.

Reproducible.description: The records may be republished, with the credit the terms ask.

CiteOnly.description: The records are computed on and cited, never republished.

ShareAlike.description: The records may be republished under the same terms, which every derived record carries.

NonCommercial.description: The records may be republished for non-commercial use only.

LICENSE_ID.description:
Identifier of the terms LICENSE_CLASS was read from: an SPDX license
identifier where one applies, else the identifier of the terms in the
provider's licence register.

LINEAGE.description:
Identifier of the lineage the source's data descends from. Sources that
republish one upstream share its lineage, so their products are not
independent of each other.

SOURCE_URL.description:
Replayable URL or provider query identifying the source material as it
was retrieved (the SOURCE_URL of $CMR and $AVL).

SOURCE_VERSION.description:
Source revision, edition or upstream update marker verbatim: for a file
its originator stamps, the stamp.

RETRIEVED_AT.description: RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond time the source material was retrieved.

SOURCE_SHA256.description:
SHA-256 of the exact source payload bytes as retrieved, 64 lowercase
hexadecimal characters. Empty when the source cannot expose replayable
bytes.

SOURCE_BYTES.description:
Number of source bytes SOURCE_SHA256 covers: the length of the prefix when
the source was fetched by range. 0 when not stated.

PRODUCER_SHA256.description:
SHA-256 of the build of PRODUCER that made the product (its dist
module.wasm), 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters. Stamped by the host
that loaded the producing module: a module cannot hash its own bytes.
Empty when not stated.

RBFStructureFeature.description: Radial magnetospheric feature (torus, moon sweep gap, ring absorption, or slot region).

MOON_SWEEP_GAP.description: Radial depletion gap swept out by a planetary moon.

RING_ABSORPTION_GAP.description: Particle absorption gap caused by planetary rings.

SLOT_REGION.description: Electron slot region between inner and outer belts.

RADIAL_MIN_RB.description: Inner radial boundary in planetary radii (R_b).

RADIAL_MAX_RB.description: Outer radial boundary in planetary radii (R_b).

ATTENUATION_FACTOR.description: Multiplicative flux attenuation (or enhancement) factor in this feature.

RBFSaaContour.description: Computed South Atlantic Anomaly (or planetary magnetic anomaly) iso-flux contour.

FLUX_THRESHOLD.description: Flux threshold defining this contour boundary.

FLUX_UNITS.description: Physical units of FLUX_THRESHOLD and PEAK_FLUX.

LATITUDES_DEG.description: Ordered polygon vertex latitudes in degrees.

LONGITUDES_DEG.description: Ordered polygon vertex longitudes in degrees.

PEAK_FLUX.description: Peak flux inside the anomaly contour.

PEAK_LAT_DEG.description: Latitude of peak anomaly flux in degrees.

PEAK_LON_DEG.description: Longitude of peak anomaly flux in degrees.

RBF_ID.description: Unique identifier of this radiation belt flux record.

VOYAGER_EMPIRICAL.description: Ice-giant Voyager empirical trapped radiation model.

IO_PLASMA_TORUS.description: Io plasma torus density and heavy-ion environment model.

CUSTOM.description: Custom or externally supplied flux table.

MAG_MODEL_ID.description: Underlying planetary magnetic field model identifier.

FLUX_TYPE.description: Flux or plasma density representation kind.

OMNIDIRECTIONAL_INTEGRAL.description: Omnidirectional integral flux above energy threshold E (cm^-2 s^-1).

OMNIDIRECTIONAL_DIFFERENTIAL.description: Omnidirectional differential flux at energy E (cm^-2 s^-1 MeV^-1).

UNIDIRECTIONAL_DIFFERENTIAL.description: Unidirectional differential flux (cm^-2 s^-1 MeV^-1 sr^-1).

PLASMA_DENSITY.description: Cold or warm plasma number density (cm^-3).

UNITS.description: Physical units string for FLUX_GRID (e.g. "cm^-2 s^-1", "cm^-2 s^-1 MeV^-1 sr^-1", "cm^-3").

EPOCH.description: Valid epoch for the model state, RFC 3339 UTC.

KP.description: Geomagnetic Kp index driving the model state (meaningful when HAS_KP is true).

HAS_KP.description: True when KP was supplied to the model.

DST_NT.description: Disturbance storm time index Dst in nT (meaningful when HAS_DST_NT is true).

HAS_DST_NT.description: True when DST_NT was supplied to the model.

F107.description: 10.7 cm solar radio flux F10.7 in sfu (meaningful when HAS_F107 is true).

HAS_F107.description: True when F107 was supplied to the model.

SOLAR_WIND_PRESSURE_NPA.description: Solar wind dynamic pressure in nPa (meaningful when HAS_SOLAR_WIND_PRESSURE is true).

HAS_SOLAR_WIND_PRESSURE.description: True when SOLAR_WIND_PRESSURE_NPA was supplied to the model.

QUANTILE_PCT.description: Statistical percentile/quantile for probabilistic belt models (0..100, default median 50.0).

L_SHELLS.description: McIlwain L-shell grid coordinates in planetary radii.

ENERGY_MEV.description: Particle kinetic energy grid coordinates in MeV.

B_OVER_B0.description: Magnetic field ratio B/B0 grid coordinates along field lines.

FLUX_GRID.description: Flattened row-major flux values indexed by [L, E, B/B0].

STRUCTURES.description: Magnetospheric structures (tori, moon sweep gaps, ring absorption, slot region).

SAA_CONTOURS.description: Computed anomaly contours (e.g. South Atlantic Anomaly at reference altitudes).
